paite: Hon enzuite hi un, kei leng Khrist enzuipa ka hih mah bang in.
english: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

paite: Huan bangkim a na hon theihgige ziak un leh thukhah ka hon hilh bang a na vom tinten ziak un ka hon phat ahi.
heading: Khristian Biakna A Lukhuh Thu
english: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

paite: Himahleh pasal peuhmah lutang Khrist ahi, numei lutang pasal ahi, Khrist lutang Pathian ahi chih na theih uh ka deih hi.
english: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

paite: Pasal alu khuh kawm a thum hiam, thu gen hiam peuhmah in, alu aselphou hi.
english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

paite: Himahleh numei alu khuh lou a thum hiam, thu gen hiam peuhmah in alu selphou ahi; metmai toh kibang ahi.
english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

paite: Numei alu khuh lou a a-om ngalleh met vanglak hen. Himahleh, numei a ding a sam met leh metmai azumhuaileh alu khuh hen.
english: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

paite: Pasal zaw Pathian batpih leh thupina ahih ziak in alu akhuh ding hilou himhim ahi; numei bel pasal thupina ahi.
english: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

paite: Numei a kipan pasal pawt ahi kei a; numei bel pasal a kipan a pawt ahi zaw hi;
english: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

paite: numei a dia pasal siam ahi kei a; numei bel pasal a dia siam ahi zaw hi.
english: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

paite: Huaiziak in angelte ziak in numei in pasal thuneihna chiamtehna akhuk ding ahi.
english: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

paite: Himahleh Toupa thilgeldan ah, pasal lou in numei a-om thei kei a, pasal leng numei lou in a-om thei sam kei hi.
english: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

paite: Pasal a kipan a numei pawt ahih bang in, pasal leng numei lak a piang ahi ngal a; himahleh bangkim Pathian a kipan a pawt vek ahi.
english: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

paite: Noumau kingaihtuah dih ua, numei in alu khuh lou a Pathian kiang a thum akilawm hiam?
english: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

paite: Pasal in samsau aneihleh amah a ding in azumhuai ahi chih na lungtang pianpih un leng ahon theisak kei a hia?
english: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

paite: Numei in bel samsau aneihleh amah a ding in thupina ahi zaw; kikhuhna ding a asam piak ahih ziak in.
english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

paite: Himahleh mi kuahiam hiai thu a agenhakleh huchibang paidan himhim i nei kei ua, Pathian saptuam pawlte'n leng anei sam kei uhi.
english: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

paite: Himahleh nou hiai thu ka hon hilhna ah ka hon phat thei kei, na hoihsemna ding uh hilou in, na siatsemna ding ua na kikhop nak ziak un.
heading: Toupa Nitak Ankuang Hihnitna / (Mat 26.26-29; Mar 14.22-25; Luk 22.14-20)
english: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

paite: Amasapen in saptuamte na kikhop un, na lak uah kilangkhenna a-om chih ka za a; gin leng ka gingta sim hi.
english: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

paite: Na lak ua ataktakte alattheihna ding un, na lak ua gintuamna leng a-om sam ding him ahi.
english: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

paite: Na hong kikhop ua na nekkhawm uh Toupa nitak an ahi kei hi;
english: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.

paite: Michih in na nek chiang un noumau nitak an na ne masa zel ngal ua; huchi in mi khat gil akial a, adang in akham hi.
english: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

paite: Bangchidan ahia? Nek leh dawnna ding inn na nei kei ua hia? Ahihkeileh Pathian saptuamte musit in, bangmah neiloute na selphou ua hia? Na kiang uah bang ka genta dia? K'on phat dia hia? Hiai lam thu ah ka hon phat thei kei hi.
english: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.

paite: Ka thu hon hilhsawn Toupa kiang a kipan ka muh ahi, huchi a Toupa Jesu'n matsak a a-om zan a, tanghou alak a,
english: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

paite: kipahthu agen khit a abalkhap a, "Hiai ka pumpi nou a dia piak ahi, keimah theihgigena in hiai hih zel un,” achih.
english: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”

paite: Huchi mah bang a nitak an anek khit a nou leng alak a, "Hiai nou ka sisan a thukhun thak ahi, na dawn teng un keimah theihgigena in hih zel un," achih.
english: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”

paite: Huai tanghou na nek ua, nou na dawn teng un ahong pai nawn masiah, Toupa sihna na puangzak uhi.
english: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

paite: Huaiziak in kuapeuh kilawmloutak a tanghou ne hiam, Toupa nou dawn hiam in Toupa pumpi leh sisan tung ah siam louh atang ding hi.
english: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

paite: Huchi in michih amah ki-enchian zaw hen, huchibang in tanghou ne in nou dawn hen.
english: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

paite: Ane leh dawn in Toupa pumpi ngenteltak a angaihtuah keileh amah tung a vaihawmna ding in ane in adawn hi.
english: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

paite: Hiai ziak in na lak ua mi tampi na hat kei ua, na zawngkhal ua, tampi'n na sihloh uhi.
english: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

paite: Himahleh ngenteltak in eimah kingaihtuah zel lehang, vai hawmsak a om nak lou ding i hi uhi.
english: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

paite: Himahleh vai hawmsak a i om in leng khovel toh siam louh tang a i omlouhna ding in Toupa taihilh in i om zel ahi.
english: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

paite: Huaiziak in ka unaute aw, ne ding a na kikhop un kingak chiat un.
english: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

paite: Na kikhop uh vaihawmna na thuakpihlouhna ding un, kuapeuh in agil akialleh a-inn lam ah ne masa hen. Huan thudang zaw ka hong pai chiang in ka bawllem ding hi.
english: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.
